name: Metric
description:
A number with its trend — the R7.2 container showcase. One component, three tiers chosen by
the box it is given (width AND height), so it fits a table cell, a header, a tile and a pane:

  micro    height < 5rem or width < 10rem: label, value, delta and an inline sparkline in one row
  compact  a tile: label, value, delta, and a small chart without axes when height allows
  full     ≥ 20rem × 12rem: value, delta and comparison, min/avg/max, the chart with a time
           axis and a hover crosshair whose readout replaces the value

It fills its box (container-type: size), so the parent must give it a definite height.
signature: ({ label, value, unit, format, delta, deltaUnit, deltaLabel, better, data, times, range, domain, tone, locale: localeProp, className, ...rest }: MetricProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: better
props.description: Which direction is good. CPU and latency: "down"; uptime: "up"; "none" for neutral.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change against the comparison period, in `deltaUnit`.

props.name: deltaLabel
props.description: The comparison, shown where there is room: "vs previous hour".

props.name: domain
props.description: Fixed value range, e.g. [0, 100] for percentages.

props.name: locale
props.description:
BCP 47 locale for the value, delta and statistics. Default: the nearest
`LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`, then en-US.

props.name: range
props.description: The period the series covers: "Last hour".

props.name: times
props.description: A label per data point for the hover readout ("10:32").

props.name: tone
props.description: The series' state, when it has one (warning when a threshold is crossed).

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit displayed with a numeric value.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value; null while unknown.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
